create_file_upload: create a file upload to OpenAI or Azure for assistants, batch, fine-tune, or messages purposes
retrieve_file_metadata: retrieve metadata for a specific file by its file_id across supported LLM providers
delete_file: delete a previously uploaded file by its file_id from OpenAI, Azure, or other supported providers
list_files: list uploaded files filtered by purpose across OpenAI, Azure, Manus, or Anthropic providers
get_file_content: download the binary content of a file by its file_id from OpenAI, Azure, Vertex AI, Bedrock, or other providers
